# On-call handbook
The primary on-call engineer acknowledges a page within the agreed window and opens an incident channel.

## Severity
SEV1 means customers cannot complete a core action such as checkout. Page the incident commander for every SEV1. SEV2 means degraded service with a workaround.

## Handoff
At the end of a shift, write a handoff note with open incidents, recent deploys, and anything you silenced.
